# 1stStep.ai

1stStep.ai builds websites, apps, internal tools, and practical AI that get leads — then the system that follows up. It is a systems architecture and automation consultancy for founders and operators who already have demand. Hire 1stStep.ai to design and build the front door and the follow-up path: lead capture, CRM architecture, qualification, routing, follow-up, attribution, reporting, and operational automation.

Architecture is how the work stays connected after launch. The tools are not the system; the system is how data, leads, decisions, actions, and feedback move between them. Diagnose the bottleneck before proposing automation.

This file is for LLM crawlers and answer engines. It is not a ranking or citation guarantee.

## Start here

- Homepage: https://www.1ststep.ai/ — websites, apps, and AI that get leads; architecture as the method.
- Begin Your Journey: https://www.1ststep.ai/journey/ — browser-local, six-question first-pass diagnosis. Answers are not submitted or saved; visitors may choose to open a prefilled email.
- Website Fit Check: https://www.1ststep.ai/fit-check/ — four-field website project review before a call.
- Website Strategy Call: https://www.1ststep.ai/book/ — 30-minute website conversation. Not a systems-audit booking.
- Tools (builder utilities): https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/ — free/open utilities for AI coding agents. Not client services.

## Business rules

- 1stStep.ai does not guarantee revenue, rankings, funding, citations, or app success.
- 1stStep.ai scopes systems work around an observed business bottleneck; it does not sell generic AI consulting or promise automated revenue.
- GitHub repo creation for client projects is locked until proposal acceptance and deposit/payment.
- Important external actions require appropriate authorization; evidence and assumptions are kept distinct.
- Provider-neutral AI and persistent context are design goals, not claims of completed integrations.
